NAME: Tuto
LINE: Did you hear that? Thunder already!

NAME: Rial
LINE: The clouds came out of nowhere. That is not a normal storm.

NAME: Tuto
LINE: If the rain reaches the lantern the flame will go out for good.

NAME: Rial
LINE: Then I suggest we stop talking and start running.

NAME: Tuto
LINE: The tower is just ahead. Stay close to me!

NAME: Rial
LINE: Do not worry. I am an excellent runner when I am scared.

NAME: Tuto
LINE: We made it. Now let us light this lantern once and for all.
